tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
replacements = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
}
for name in ['pipeline/processor.go', 'pipeline/stage_input.go', 'pipeline/stage_validation.go', 'pipeline/stage_normalization.go', 'pipeline/stage_mapping.go', 'pipeline/stage_routing.go']:
    path = Path(name)
    content = path.read_text()
    for old, new in replacements.items():
        content = content.replace(old, new)
    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=f'.{path.name}.')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        os.replace(temp_name, path)
    except BaseException:
        os.unlink(temp_name)
        raise
PY
rg -n 'LoadInput|CheckInput|NormalizeValue|MapFields|RouteValue|ReadRequest|ValidateRequest|CanonicalizeValue|ProjectFields|DispatchValue' --glob '*.go'"
